# PROGRAMMA PYAT HQ — Operational decision HQR-20261112-01

**DECISION: CONDITIONAL GO.** User-directed functional HQ determination of the requested adversarial implementation method. This comment supersedes the *reconnaissance-only restriction only for the specifically authorized sourcefree pilot named below*, not the scientific/source, protected integration or paused-worker restrictions in #909/#918–920.

## Factual receiving baseline (verified 2026-11-12)
- Protected `integration/pre-main-reconciliation-r1@6a5c12f04323d74001f9632063ec907f4fc4468e`; Oct 28 SOURCE-AUTHORITATIVE / COMPACT / REGENERABLE-HYBRID remains the selected physical architecture. #910 @ `07694d27ed080560d082eba7491f4f8f5a7fec9b` is S0–S1 draft/REVISE-HOLD, not an accepted physical implementation.
- W03/W04 HQ remains **USER PAUSED** @ `e31fea5ad65e9d9664cdc06bdf6ccb3a3c416ef0`; separate writer @ `f420c2cdac0e2c537f7719de68c9f74e5514aa07`. Never write on those worktrees/branches or silently absorb unaccepted implementations.
- C-1 #922 @ `b0ebb531bc61d7ce0435eb6e0a2d85d66f5c3819`: production-path sourcefree cache-key repair and actual I03 first-reader preservation; CI `43163524051` SUCCESS plus canonical CI at current head. **Candidate S2, independent terminal receiving not performed.**
- C-2 #923 @ `fc6b75ec83795931df5d8f47d7a31553198ca05a`: complete object-ref custody does NOT prove semantic-selector-range completeness. Six standalone model tests; **S1/S2-model contract only, native reader NOT IMPLEMENTED**. No PR-head Actions runs found.
- C-3 #921 @ `18b189b36b6661865a053b055199f845ea44b156` and successor #925 @ `265526a69c3a7a52365cf908709a4ef85ef9092e`: source-contradiction guard at C→D and FF01 upstream-laundering repair; #925 includes/conserves B's work; current CI `43164300953` SUCCESS plus canonical CI, **candidate sourcefree S2, not independently received**. #921 and #925 must NOT be merged separately.
- SOROK #917/#924 is corroborating **method** evidence only; separate source/owner, not PYAT receiving authority.

## Architecture and execution law
ONE source-authoritative compact physical C11 estate; governed semantic/irreducible sidecars; complete I02 logical and physical certification; authentically complete semantic-selector ranges and absence; native I03/I05/Batch scientific owners; FIABC-style exact durable output factoring; M1/M2/B5 lifecycle under independently anchored custody. The production DAG forks from S04 into S05, direct N10E and descriptive FF01, with separately warranted structural FF02→conditional N6/N9. No mandatory S05→FF serial chain, new A/B/C bakeoff, parallel full object corpus, SQL science owner, or autonomous causal/social-position issuance.

**Three ledgers, kept separate:** (1) engineering functioning/first-consumer parity; (2) semantic/scientific claim qualification and evidence grade; (3) current permission/issuer and production custody. Green in one never promotes another.

## Frozen ordered obligation queue (not 17 automatically authorized workers)
Classes: A=accepted at specified grade; C=candidate awaiting independent receiving; B=buildable gap; H=external source/science/rights hold. A C-class candidate does NOT mean accepted.

| Order | ID | Disposition now | Next meaningful completion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | C1-02 | **C** #922 executable sourcefree cache repair | Receive hostile red/green equivalence + regression; if accepted reuse in source-direct ingress |
| 0 | C3-01 | **C** #925 successor of #921 | Receive upstream and downstream contradiction controls, pinned-source origin; retain limited sourcefree grade |
| 1 | C2-02 | **B / pilot** #923 model contract only | Build and falsify native-selector-compatible authenticated complete semantic ranges |
| 2 | C1-01 | **S1 partial** scientific front-door design | Exact irreducible determinants/sidecar/source mappings and source→operation ABI; H original-science gaps |
| 2 | C1-04 | **B/H** sourcefree current-use repair, external issuer held | No current permission inferred from cached/old record; negative states intact |
| 3 | C2-01 | **B** global I02 certification | Deterministic external-memory exhaustive joins, replay, occurrence, original source lineage, independently trusted seal |
| 4 | C2-03 | **B** verified persisted-reader | One source-direct Parquet/Zstd saved estate, selected positive/negative reads after cold reopen; no whole C11 rehydrate |
| 5 | C2-04 | **B** native access adaptation | Direct I03, I05, Batch, issued and joined-resume first readers receive same trusted store |
| 5 | C1-03 | **B/H** operation completeness | Actual selected U_item/U_unit/U_app/E_pre and truthful fate ledger; original35 rights/coverage independently held |
| 6 | C2-06 | **B** general durable scientific closure; **reusable FIABC sourcefree capital** | Exact facts/negatives, queries, predicates, authorities, risk/denominator, provenance and replay, restore/first consumer |
| 6 | C2-05 | **B** scale/economics proof | Whole retained bytes, process-tree RSS, cold/repeated native first-reader and crash/resume; no 6GiB breach |
| 7 | C2-07 | **B/H** B5 checkpoint/replay already implemented locally | External CAS custody, independent issuer/currentness, M1/M2/B5 durable as-of/first consumer |
| 8 | C3-02 | **B** currently narrow frozen Q86 RAW single-universe FF01 | Source-neutral claim-bounded empirical ingress with exact rights/risk/weight/negative semantics |
| 9 | C3-03 | **Existing gate / H positive rule** | Current structural-admission code preserved; new causal/structural positive requires competent source/science authority |
| 9 | C3-04 | **Materializer already merged / H actual position producer** | Source-qualified position/institution/ownership/power/time producer with independent disposition ancestry |
| 10 | C3-05 | **Sourcefree partial / H native world** | Conditional N6/N9 actual first reader and as-of matching; N10E independent; no FF universal gate |

This is a dependency order, not a demand that C-1 research or C-3 bounded corrections wait for unrelated code. Resolve *actual* independent tasks in parallel only with noncolliding writer custody. Previously completed narrowly scoped functionality should be reused, not rebuilt.

## FIRST IMPLEMENTATION PILOT — C2-02 inside #919
**Pilot scope explicitly AUTHORIZED at isolated SOURCEFREE S2 engineering grade.** Construct one actual native-selector-compatible, authenticated **complete semantic-range read** from an existing genuinely I02-validated *sourcefree* C11 fixture, including all native/canonical/component/state/occurrence identities and authenticated empty selection. Bind selector multimap proofs to the independently fixed complete corpus/root: object-ref membership proofs alone do not suffice. Provide bounded cursor, not `inventory_refs() -> tuple`. Preserve exact source, universe, authority, event multiplicity, order, rank and routing uncertainty. Reuse the actual `_pre553_query_predicate._select_respondent_events` selection semantics and demonstrate a native I03 fact/negative first-consumer comparison, not just a standalone dictionary simulation.

**Owned code boundary:** an isolated new private certified-selector module plus tests; permitted minimal adapter/test seam only after proving no overlap with paused W03/W04 writer ownership. Do NOT edit `pre553_parquet_carrier.py`, `pre553_source_backed_c11_facade.py`, W03/W04 source paths or public replay schemas in this pilot. Future C2-01/C2-03 will integrate its index root into the complete I02 proof transaction and the actual source-direct Parquet writer; the pilot alone is NOT accepted I02 physical publication.

**Base/read set:** protected `6a5c12f04323d74001f9632063ec907f4fc4468e`; #919 original; #923 @ `fc6b75ec83795931df5d8f47d7a31553198ca05a`; `rawlsing_next/_pre553_query_predicate.py::_select_respondent_events/_build_release_index`, `_pre553_query_common.py::_ReleaseIndex`, `pre553_c11_ingest.py`, `pre553_c11_integrity.py`, `pre553_c11_repository.py`; existing sourcefree I03 fixtures. Historic accepted release object may be used as an oracle; it is not a license to require full objects at *saved-query* time.

**Mandatory executable red/green:** H26 intact full corpus with dropped second occurrence in poisoned selector → REFUSE/rebuild; H27 omitted authorized canonical/component alias → REFUSE/rebuild; H28 empty range + unknown routing → no observed zero/not-applicable invention; H29 valid proof for wrong universe/source/release/root → REFUSE; H30 bounded inventory/read and measured process-tree memory; all-states vs explicit empty-state filter; native_only precedence; repeated/ranked event multiplicity; exact I03 fact/negative comparator; cold reopen/changed-value and corrupt-range negative when there is a real persisted pilot artifact. Where an H requires later full persisted machinery, classify NOT_RUN and DO NOT claim that full item was achieved.

**Pilot stop rule:** nontrivial actual-native positive and adversarial negative with immutable code/tests and a tested frozen HEAD, full in-scope regression, clearly identified remaining physical proof gaps, no fabricated native source authority. If the first pilot cannot reach native I03 without modifying paused-owned code, report exact collision and PAUSE rather than evade with a toy demonstration.

## Adversarial A/B relay, no extra permission rounds
1. Establish separate branch/worktree with **verified** exclusive writer lease and no W03/W04 collision; record exact base HEAD, input readset, first consumer and currently authorized grade in #919. **No lease = no code mutation.** A owns first implementation.
2. B independently reconstructs #919 + #923 and the actual A code, runs hostile tests, then fixes consequential defects on *its own successor branch* based on frozen A HEAD. Never both write one branch.
3. Exchange immutable artifacts with exact code SHA, test commands/CI, failures, preservation matrix, known unproved cuts. A may counterattack B's new frozen code. Each handoff carries entire original acceptance contract.
4. No per-round HQ permission needed *within this pilot's authorized sourcefree files/functions*. Escalate only for interface ownership change, protected/source/science authority, writer collision, a proposed new storage/scientific owner, or material change to October 28.
5. End when all in-scope tests/first-reader obligations pass, no identified feasible consequential defect remains, and remainder is **explicitly** higher-grade or blocked. No unlimited exchanges. Freeze single successor HEAD; keep older PRs historical, never merge incompatible A/B candidates separately.
6. Independent NONAUTHOR receiving against frozen HEAD is mandatory before programmatic integration. Distinct conversation contexts alone do not prove review impartiality. The receiving result is ACCEPT_SCOPED / REVISE_EXACT_DEFECT / HOLD_EXTERNAL; no silent self-acceptance.

## Succession and next-authority gates
- #918/#922 and #920/#925 are already sourcefree implementation candidates. Permit **same-item** bounded adversarial repair/receiving; no wholesale new implementation estate. A newly identified important defect may be corrected within owned paths without recurring HQ issuance.
- #919 **alone** is amended to permit C2-02 pilot sourcefree code. Other C2 stages remain ordered potential assignments, **not automatically issued implementation commissions**. Advance after independently receiving pilot or recording a genuine external hold; HQ may clear subsequent bounded stages based on no-collision evidence.
- At acceptance integrate through **one** exact-head successor chain into the Oct 28 design and corrected #910 contract. Preserve historical PR roots and tests, retire subsumed duplicated code. One authoritative C11 producer/reader and native scientific owners. No protected merge without distinct protected receiving authority.
- Original35 source-native work, external source rights/host, broad scientific/structural/actor claims, new positive position/power rule, and paused W03/W04 HQ remain **HELD**. Do not promote sourcefree S2 to native S3 or treat self-hashed currentness as a trusted issuer.

**This is HQ's operational answer to the supplied brief, not proof that agents have been dispatched or are currently executing.**

# HQR-20261112-02 — SUPERSEDING PROGRAMME ORGANIZATION

**HQ ruling, in response to explicit user direction: PROGRAMME GO for adversarial construction of the authorized sourcefree engineering machine, organized into THREE standing implementation pairs.** This supplements HQR-20261112-01 in [earlier HQ comment](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/909#issuecomment-6816118288) and **supersedes its C2-02-only future implementation-authorization limit**. Its architectural, proof, W03/W04 pause, source-science-rights, lease and protected-receiving restrictions remain binding.

**The commission is the contract. Actual implementation is the work. Adversarial exchange is the method. Independent receiving establishes the achieved grade.**

There shall be **THREE pairs = SIX separately instantiated A/B implementation agents**, plus **ONE independent nonauthor receiving function** and HQ for architecture/ownership/cross-stage integration. No additional pairs now. Pair members do not share a writable branch or lease. A and B may iteratively improve one working candidate at a time; every round inherits the *entire original item acceptance contract*, not merely the last correction.

## Standing commission owners, full S01–S11 coverage
1. **Pair 1 / [#918 implementation amendment](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/918#issuecomment-6816210183): P1-01..P1-07 (7 items), S01–S02 source/administration/semantics, issued-frontier, source-bound projection and current rights.** Begin by independently receiving or repairing executable #922 @ `b0ebb531bc61d7ce0435eb6e0a2d85d66f5c3819` at bounded sourcefree grade; implement the complete source-direct semantic front door and actual operation fates.
2. **Pair 2 / [#919 implementation amendment](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/919#issuecomment-6816210790): P2-01..P2-09 (9 items), S03–S05 certified compact estate, full I02, authenticated saved read, native I03/I05/Batch, exact F1–F4 and learned M1/M2/B5 products.** First item #923 @ `fc6b75ec83795931df5d8f47d7a31553198ca05a` native complete-semantic-selector proof and actual I03 first reader; do not mistake #923's six standalone tests for implementation. Subsequent items make one compact Oct28 Parquet/Zstd source-direct estate with sidecars and FIABC-style durable output.
3. **Pair 3 / [#920 implementation amendment](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/920#issuecomment-6816211446): P3-01..P3-09 (9 items), S06–S11 descriptive FF01, independently warranted FF02 position/power, conditional F6/F7, N9, N10E/N10W and N11/N12 terminal gates.** First item independently receive/repair #925 @ `265526a69c3a7a52365cf908709a4ef85ef9092e`, preserving #921 @ `18b189b36b6661865a053b055199f845ea44b156` without independently merging both. Structural scientific/actor positive source authority remains held.

**25 items = one finite queue per pair, not 25 separate issues/agent deployments.** Items may be further subdivided into bounded implementation units when needed, but every subunit must end with an actual first-consumer changed-value/refusal test and inherit its parent evidence obligations. Do not mistake a test toy for native code.

## Cross-pair dependency synchronization (no artificial serial pipeline)
- **Gate G0:** independent code review/receiving for #922 and #925; build P2-01 against existing valid sealed sourcefree C11 fixture.
- **Gate G1:** Pair 1 freezes exact source/semantic/sidecar/operation input ABI; Pair 2 returns accepted verified-semantic-range ABI; Pair 3 freezes descriptive FF01 fact-origin and claim-grade output ABI. One integrating review verifies cross-pair noncontradiction before modifying common interfaces.
- **Gate G2:** Pair 1's decoder/issued frontier feeds Pair 2's I02 certificate + compact Parquet writer and saved reader; Pair 2's native I03/I05/Batch first reader is the sourcefree end-to-end proof.
- **Gate G3:** Pair 2 completes durable exact F1–F4/I05/M1/M2/B5 closure; Pair 3 receives it through S04 branches (S05 / descriptive FF01 / N10E independent), then conditional FF02/F6/F7/N9/N10.
- **Gate G4:** independent source/measurement/current rights qualification and N11 original35 acceptance (35×54 axes) only under competent owner; N12 Sorok wake/defer is **separate authority**, never automatic upon engineering green.

Cross-pair dependencies are **versioned contracts and tested exact artifacts**, not shared mutable code. If a proposed change crosses the file/interface ownership boundary, write a bounded handoff and obtain HQ owner agreement; no simultaneous writes to a common Python module. Pair 3's F6/F7 are conditional, NOT universal pipeline gates.

## A/B implementation relay and acceptance
Each task: (1) pin live protected HEAD and governing source/owner, verify **exclusive actual writer lease** (no lease → no mutation), freeze actual first consumer and positive/negative/cold/replay oracle; (2) A implements strongest permitted sourcefree code + tests, discloses unproved cuts; (3) B independently reconstructs contract and challenges it before reading A's self-narration, then attempts substantive repairs on separate descendant branch; (4) A counterattacks; repeat only while material, feasible gaps remain; (5) freeze one accepted-candidate ancestry at immutable tested SHA; (6) ONE genuinely independent terminal receiver checks original entire item contract and issues ACCEPT_SCOPED, REVISE_EXACT_DEFECT or HOLD_EXTERNAL; (7) only accepted/held items advance to next queue entry, no per-round HQ approval needed inside accepted lane ownership. A/B cannot self-accept or merge protected.

**Metrics:** separate (a) proven implementation depth + regressions and first consumer, (b) breadth of original required functions completed, (c) scientific/source/permission qualification. CI green is not automatic acceptance; no unconditional completion based on a model or synthetic fixture.

## Nonnegotiable engineering destination
[Oct 28 selected one architecture](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/blob/315251451a6d112fb312a6a2e80b096d345c5de6/PYAT_CONTROL_ROOM/FINAL_PRODUCTION_ARCHITECTURE_HQ_20261028_R1/01_EXECUTIVE_ADJUDICATION.md): source-authoritative compact regenerable hybrid, source-direct respondent-aligned Parquet/Zstd + necessary semantic/exception sidecars, a complete externally anchored I02 proof and authenticated reader (including semantic selector nonmembership), no mandatory duplicate object-shaped C11, no new statistics engine. FIABC factoring of exact retained scientific output. #910 R2 remains S0–S1 REVISE/HOLD and must be reconciled to this route before final whole-programme integration. The output DAG forks S04→S05, S04→descriptive FF01, S04→N10E; FF02, F6, F7, N9, N10W and N11/N12 only on their actual AND/IF conditions.

## HOLDs, not permissions
- W03/W04 HQ remains USER PAUSED @ `e31fea5ad65e9d9664cdc06bdf6ccb3a3c416ef0`; no edits to active writer `f420c2cdac0e2c537f7719de68c9f74e5514aa07`, no silent adoption.
- No original35 restricted source use, real source rights, original35 scientific acceptance, causal/structural authority, actor/person issuance, N12 wake or protected merges granted here.
- Agent roles/conversations/leases are not instantiated by this comment. A **real agent startup and writer lease verification** are prerequisites to execution.
- No new architecture commissions, new fleet, or 25 micro-issues without a consequential ownership reason. This programme is a **work queue**, not another administrative estate.

**This is the controlling functional-HQ implementation programme.**

# HQR-20261112-R3C — BINDING PACKET COMPLETION / ADVERSARIAL SATURATION COURT

**This is an acceptance-contract amendment to [R3's 20-packet programme](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/909#issuecomment-6817019151), NOT a new architecture, implementation phase, commission, or source/science grant.** It applies to [Pair1 #918](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/918), [Pair2 #919](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/919), [Pair3 #920](https://github.com/maidiu/rawlsing/issues/920). It addresses an omission in R3: named falsifiers alone do not establish a mechanically adjudicable end condition, and "no consequential feasible defects remain" without a severity/evidence rule invites both premature claims and endless exchanges.

## I. Closed outcomes and accounting (never conflate)
Every packet must end with exactly one signed **engineering disposition** at its actual evidence grade:
- `ACCEPT_SCOPED`: implemented or existing code demonstrably satisfies **all in-scope hard gates**, independent nonauthor receiver accepts exact frozen SHA. May carry separately named native/scientific/host/actor external HOLDs. This means **packet engineering accepted**, NOT protected merge, original35 scientific acceptance or whole machine completion.
- `ALREADY_SATISFIED`: exact existing accepted/protected owner and actual first-consumer proofs meet the same contract at the same grade; independent receiver verifies that doing nothing is valid. A source stub/import is not sufficient.
- `REVISE_EXACT_DEFECT`: reproducible, consequential, **in-scope and feasible** failure against one specified gate; submit failing command/input/expected/observed, exact owner, suggested minimal repair. This cannot be called complete.
- `HOLD_EXTERNAL`: every feasible in-scope implementation/proof has been done or boundedly attempted and a specified missing competent source, issuer, science rule, actor/host or rights decision prevents the remaining positive evidence. Identify precisely the external owner and smallest witness. **Do not mark a sourcefree engineering bug HOLD simply because original35 permission is unavailable.** A HOLD is honest terminal *for that claim/grade*, not `ACCEPT_SCOPED` for unimplemented functionality.
- `NOT_DEMANDED_PROVED`: only for an IF-conditional packet, citing the exact selected consumer/IF rule that makes the function inapplicable in the current target scope, and preserving the pending broader conditional obligation. No speculative implementation or blanket deletion.
- `BLOCKED_OWNERSHIP`: required writer lease, file owner, frozen immutable input or authorized scope unavailable; identify conflicting owner and do not mutate. Not a success.
A separate **integration flag** `UNMERGED | ACCEPTED_INTEGRATION_BRANCH | PROTECTED_RECEIVED` must accompany every engineering disposition. No agent may mark `PROTECTED_RECEIVED` without protected receiving's actual commit/decision.

## II. Five binary receipt gates per packet — proof OR explicit lawful exception
`G1 EXACT CONTRACT`: Original R3 packet ID(s), selected source/semantic/scientific owner, immutable tested base+candidate HEAD and source blob, *actual* first consumer and governing input/output ABIs, accepted scope and typed negative statuses. Pass only if **all original packet obligations are accounted for** (including anything collapsed from old 25).
`G2 REAL EXECUTABLE POSITIVE`: Working module/function **and actual normal first-reader invocation**, changed valid upstream input -> changed expected result/identity, restoration -> original exact output, or for receive-only packet a rerun of the existing implementation's real first-consumer tests. Model-only/unit-only, imported symbol, constructed record or passing self-rehash is **NOT** native first-consumer proof. For a strictly negative gate, use an actual first-consumer refusal and valid restored positive.
`G3 HOSTILE NEGATIVE + CONSERVATION`: Mandatory item-specific RED controls, exact source/universe/authority/as-of binding, illegal widening/absence/zero/currentness denied, non-loss of already accepted functionality, exhaustive source/operation/fact/negative/held states within **declared input census**, regression suite and known historical counterexamples. Wrong source is never 'valid null'. No output-truncation or inferred origin.
`G4 CUSTODY + RESOURCES + RECOVERY`: If packet owns persistent state, certify versioned content-addressed root, independently anchored trust, corrupt/partial/orphan refusal, cold fresh-process selected read, replay/migration; if it is read-only/stateless, mark `NOT_APPLICABLE_PROVED` with no invented durability claim. If it changes physical/materialization, report exact test row count, process-tree peak RSS, elapsed cold/repeat, retained/peak disk, source-open count and cap result; do not substitute a tiny fixture for the **later integrated 100k** criterion. Whole 6 GiB test is mandatory at S2 integrated resource gate, not automatically passable by a small module test.
`G5 INDEPENDENT NONAUTHOR RECEIVING`: One reviewer other than both current A/B authors, genuinely independent of the reviewed artifact, inspects exact frozen descendant HEAD and original packet contract, reruns the critical positive/red/restoration and regression/owner/grade checks, and writes one of the closed outcomes above. **No green CI, author's self-review, A/B agreement, or prose alone satisfies G5.** Rewritten code after review invalidates G5 until received at its new SHA.

No packet may be declared `ACCEPT_SCOPED` if any applicable G1–G5 is FAIL/NOT_RUN. A test marked XFAIL, historical-passed, absent host, or theoretical is not green. If G2/G4 is genuinely impossible due external authority, record `HOLD_EXTERNAL`, while a demonstrably complete lower-grade sub-scope may separately be `ACCEPT_SCOPED@S2` with its exact boundary. Never infer S3/original35 from S2.

## III. Stop/adversarial iteration: finite without arbitrary pass
1. Before implementation, record the packet's **closed mandatory case IDs** (from pair-specific R3C comment), positive reader, negative reader, preservation suite, exact proof ceiling and fixed resource budgets. A implements strongest actual work with frozen HEAD. B independently challenges and, if it finds a consequence, repairs on its **own** branch descended from that exact A HEAD; A counter-challenges. Every challenger must report executable failure/reproduction, actual first reader, semantic consequence, scope and grade.
2. `SEV-0` = incorrect positive authority/scientific/currentness/source claim, data loss or false absence; `SEV-1` = actual eligible first-reader wrong value, incomplete required selector/denominator/operation or broken exact replay; `SEV-2` = resource violation, crash/recovery or parity/compatibility loss within agreed envelope; `SEV-3` = cosmetic/hypothetical outside demonstrated contract. Any **in-scope reproducible SEV-0/1/2 stays REVISE** until repaired and tested at frozen successor SHA or, for genuine inaccessible external evidence only, independently adjudicated HOLD. SEV-3 cannot force open-ended rounds; record deferred item without changing acceptance.
3. After A→B→A (one implement, one attack, one counterattack) **either** submit for independent receiving if every mandatory gate green, **or** make one narrow bounded correction/retest exchange for remaining specific SEV-0/1/2 cases. If defects still recur, send the exact unresolved case/source/ownership to HQ for `REVISE/HOLD/CHANGE_OWNER` adjudication—**do not automatically reopen broad reconnaissance or declare victory due a round limit.** A serious reproducible in-scope failure blocks acceptance no matter how many iterations occurred.
4. Reviewer must attempt at least one independent hostile variation not authored as a happy-path case by A/B, using the actual first reader, but is not commissioned to reinvent the scientific programme. Reviewer may `ACCEPT_SCOPED`, `REVISE_EXACT_DEFECT`, or `HOLD_EXTERNAL` against **the complete original packet contract**; no 'accepted except one in-scope red test'.
5. Upon scoped acceptance, freeze one descendant implementation HEAD and proof/receipt, mark integrated/not-integrated separately, advance to the next packet whose **genuine dependencies are present** without another HQ permission. If HOLD_EXTERNAL or NOT_DEMANDED_PROVED, move to other independent lawful packets; retain pending obligation in programme census.

## IV. Mandatory machine-readable receipt (JSON or JSONL; exact values, no prose-only pass)
```json
{
  "packet_id": "S2-A",
  "old_obligations": ["P2-01"],
  "frozen_base_sha": "<40 hex>",
  "candidate_sha": "<40 hex>",
  "changed_paths": ["..."],
  "writer_lease_and_scope": "verified exclusive or BLOCKED_OWNERSHIP",
  "actual_first_consumer": "module::call and concrete fixture",
  "evidence_grade": "S2_SOURCEFREE",
  "gates": {
    "G1": {"state": "PASS|FAIL|NOT_RUN|NOT_APPLICABLE_PROVED", "receipt": "..."},
    "G2": {"state": "PASS|FAIL|NOT_RUN|NOT_APPLICABLE_PROVED", "receipt": "..."},
    "G3": {"state": "PASS|FAIL|NOT_RUN|NOT_APPLICABLE_PROVED", "receipt": "..."},
    "G4": {"state": "PASS|FAIL|NOT_RUN|NOT_APPLICABLE_PROVED", "receipt": "..."},
    "G5": {"state": "PASS|FAIL|NOT_RUN", "reviewer": "...", "receipt": "..."}
  },
  "mandatory_cases": [{"id": "...", "result": "PASS|FAIL|NOT_RUN|XFAIL", "command": "...", "actual": "..."}],
  "preserved_functions": ["existing exact code or receipt"],
  "open_defects": [{"severity": "SEV-0|SEV-1|SEV-2|SEV-3", "case": "...", "disposition": "..."}],
  "external_holds": [{"owner": "competent external authority", "minimal_missing_witness": "..."}],
  "resource_evidence": {"rows": null, "process_tree_peak_rss_bytes": null, "retained_disk_bytes": null, "peak_disk_bytes": null, "cold_seconds": null, "repeat_seconds": null},
  "disposition": "ACCEPT_SCOPED|ALREADY_SATISFIED|REVISE_EXACT_DEFECT|HOLD_EXTERNAL|NOT_DEMANDED_PROVED|BLOCKED_OWNERSHIP",
  "integration": "UNMERGED|ACCEPTED_INTEGRATION_BRANCH|PROTECTED_RECEIVED"
}
```
Literal placeholders must be replaced in real returns. An `ACCEPT_SCOPED` receipt needs a real nonauthor G5 review, not a self-filled JSON verdict. Close packet only when exact artifact and its receiving receipt both exist.

## V. Whole-programme done (different from packet done)
`ENGINEERING_MACHINE_S2_COMPLETE` only if every required nonconditional packet is accepted at its S2 original contract, all selected IF packets accepted or `NOT_DEMANDED_PROVED` with exact selection rule, every cross-pair G1–G3 actual cold producer/consumer and resource/integrity test passes, no conservation identities lost, and the accepted implementation ancestry is integrated/independently received. `ORIGINAL35_SCIENTIFIC_COMPLETE` requires distinct permitted original35 source/measurement/U/Epre, P05, all demanded F1–F8 and N11 formal independent receipts; `N12_WAKE` belongs to separate Sorok actor/host authority. No set of sourcefree A/B iterations can self-issue these higher statuses.

## VI. Item-specific closed courts
The 20 packet-specific mandatory-positive/negative/restore/first-reader targets are appended to the **three existing commission issues** as R3C supplements. They are binding additions to, not replacements for, the governing full obligations and earlier exact-source hostile cases. A test-case name is a *required future executable test* unless its actual sourcefree implementation/result is cited; writing a name alone does not pass it.

**Standing source/lease/pause:** no new agent started, no lease granted, W03/W04 remains USER PAUSED, no original35/source/actor/scientific or protected merge granted by this comment.

# HQR-20261112-R3S — MANDATORY STOP-AND-ADVANCE RULE (ANTI-HARDENING)

**Controlling correction to R3/R3C. This is a restriction on what the A/B workers MAY do, not a sixth acceptance gate, new commission, new code-hardening project, or permission to expand any packet.** The user's objective is completion of the specified machine, not indefinite improvement of each component.

## 1. FINISH IS A TERMINAL PREDICATE
A packet is **READY_FOR_RECEIVING** immediately when (a) its frozen, packet-specific mandatory G1–G4 and positive/negative/restoration cases pass at the legitimately available evidence grade, (b) the original contract's in-scope accepted functionality is preserved, and (c) there is no **reproducible in-scope SEV-0/1/2 failure**. At that instant the pair **MUST STOP CODING ON THAT PACKET AND SUBMIT THE FROZEN HEAD FOR NONAUTHOR G5**. No extra "just in case" tests, extra defensive wrappers, refactors, API polishing, broad compatibility surveys, generalized abstractions or performance pursuits outside the numeric/resource gates. A missing *external* scientific/issuer/host input is logged as HOLD, not used to invent additional code.

Upon actual independent `ACCEPT_SCOPED` or `ALREADY_SATISFIED`, that packet becomes **TERMINAL_CLOSED at exact SHA + grade**. **STOP means STOP: no further edits, iterative rounds, new "hardening" PR, or self-issued subcommission on that packet.** Advance to the next queued dependency-ready packet. Protected merge/integration remains a **separate** received process; no reopened pair work merely to improve a finished artifact.

## 2. FROZEN ACCEPTANCE UNIVERSE — NOT A GROWING WISH LIST
Before A writes, freeze: packet ID/old IDs, permitted sourcefree grade, owned files and changed-entry owner, exact selected first consumer, mandatory positive/negative/restore case IDs, existing regression tests, applicable resource/size ceiling and mandatory HOLDs. This is the closed acceptance universe. The G1–G5 checklist embedded in each commission is part of it.

No new requirement/test/optimization may be promoted to **mandatory** during the duel merely because an agent can imagine it. A new case is admissible ONLY when it includes (i) **an executed or minimally executable reproducible counterexample** showing (ii) breach of an **already-frozen requirement** at (iii) a real selected owner/first consumer, with expected/actual/result and legitimate evidence grade. A reviewer must apply the SAME rule. "Could be safer", "might scale better", "needs more hardening", "cleaner API", "potential future use", model-only conjecture, wider original35/actor science and unrelated technical debt are **not** completion blockers. Record optional ideas as **NONBLOCKING_DEFERRED** only, without implementing them or adding them to the task's finish criteria. A novel in-scope concrete regression is legitimate; a novel goal is not.

The existing required **6 GiB**/100k test is **not** optional hardening once its specifically designated integrated physical gate is reached. It must not be retroactively imposed upon each small sourcefree task that cannot produce the integrated artifact. Conversely, no resource threshold beyond an existing authorized budget can be invented to prolong the duel.

## 3. MAXIMUM UNREVIEWED DUEL
**A implementation → B independently attacks/repairs → A one counterattack** is the normal maximum before a forced disposition. At that point:
- All frozen G1–G4/cases green and no reproduced in-scope material defect → **immediately freeze and submit G5**.
- Specific reproduced in-scope SEV-0/1/2 failure → **one bounded repair+retest**, with defect ID and actual first-reader consequence; then mandatory nonauthor receiving or HQ adjudication of the *exact* unresolved defect. There is no permission for a third broad A/B exploration cycle.
- Missing competent external evidence/permission → **HOLD_EXTERNAL** for that grade; submit the finished lower-grade implementation for G5 if it passes and move onward. Never "harden" around absence of an issuer.
- Ownership/lease collision → **BLOCKED_OWNERSHIP**, no code mutation, move to independent eligible work or seek owner ruling.

An independent reviewer can require work **only** by writing `REVISE_EXACT_DEFECT` with a reproducible in-scope failing case tied to one frozen obligation; author repairs **that case only**, then refreezes and re-receives. Reviewer cannot demand aesthetic hardening, a new generalized service or expanded proof tier as a condition of accepted scoped completion.

## 4. MINIMAL CLOSURE RECEIPT
Every packet's existing machine-readable receipt must explicitly record:
- `contract_frozen_at_sha`, `mandatory_case_ids`, `mandatory_case_results`, `first_consumer_proof`, `material_open_defects`, `external_holds`, `evidence_grade`, `independent_receiver_decision`, `integration_state`.
- `stop_state`: `IMPLEMENT | READY_FOR_RECEIVING | TERMINAL_CLOSED | HOLD_EXTERNAL | BLOCKED_OWNERSHIP | REVISE_EXACT_DEFECT`.
- `nonblocking_deferred` suggestions may be logged but **do not create work** and **cannot prevent STOP**.
- If a packet is `TERMINAL_CLOSED`, any proposed further work needs a **new demonstrated breach of a previously accepted invariant** or a **distinct subsequently authorized product requirement**; neither can be self-commissioned by A/B, and neither retroactively invalidates a correctly scoped earlier acceptance without independent proof.

## 5. COMPLETION IS NOT MORE HARDENING
`NO_IN_SCOPE_FAILURE + ALL_APPLICABLE_FROZEN_CASES_PASS + INDEPENDENT_ACCEPTANCE = FINISHED_AT_GRADE`.

For conditional packet: `NOT_DEMANDED_PROVED` is terminal for that selected scope; the broader conditional obligation remains open **only if later truly selected**. For externally blocked grade: a sourcefree `ACCEPT_SCOPED` and an explicit native `HOLD_EXTERNAL` are compatible and sufficient to **stop the engineering pair**. Do not spin waiting for original source/actor science.

This applies to **all twenty task sections in #918, #919 and #920** and supersedes any wording ("hardening", "improve until", "no feasible consequential defect remains") that might be read as indefinite permission. **A stop-rule violation is an out-of-scope commission failure, not evidence of diligence.**

**NOTE:** These are binding commission instructions and falsifiable review rules. GitHub issue text alone does not physically terminate an agent's runtime or impose branch protection; execution management must honor the terminal state. No worker/lease is created by this update.
